topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: I stumbled upon a rusty, godforsaken box half-buried in the earth behind my house, right where I’ve been clearing the overgrown brush. This thing, this metal abomination, wasn’t there when I bought the property. How dare someone litter with their time capsule nonsense on my land? I yanked it out, dust and dirt flying everywhere, and slammed it on the patio. If there’s one thing I can’t stand, it’s someone else’s forgotten junk cluttering up my space. Now I’ve got to sift through this mess to find out what idiotic trinkets from the past they’ve inflicted on me.
